answer: An AI-agent maritime economy can resist Sybil attacks via shore-based radar echo attestation. Near a harbor, coastal radars sweep an agent's ocean sector while its backscatter transponder modulates a signed nonce onto the reflected pulse. Verifiers match that return against sea clutter in one range-azimuth cell, forcing attackers to deploy separate craft and transponders across distinct cells per identity. However, heavy squalls and dense traffic scatter beams, obscuring valid returns.
